services.title: Premium Roofing Services
services.shortDescription: Full-service roof installations, leaks, shingle replacements, and inspections.
services.longDescription: Your roof is your home's first line of defense. We provide complete architectural shingle replacements, metal roofing installation, leakage diagnostics, and certified storm damage inspections. Using premium GAF materials, we guarantee a roof that will protect your family for decades.

faq.q: How long does a typical roof replacement take?
faq.a: Most residential roof replacements are completed in just 1-2 days, depending on weather and size.

faq.q: Do you work with homeowners insurance?
faq.a: Yes! We work directly with insurance adjusters to document storm damage and process claims.

services.title: Expert HVAC Services
services.shortDescription: High-efficiency heating, cooling, and air quality system maintenance.
services.longDescription: Keep your home comfortable all year long. From high-efficiency heat pumps to routine filter maintenance and system tune-ups, our certified technicians ensure your HVAC runs at peak performance, saving you money on utility bills.

faq.q: How often should I service my HVAC system?
faq.a: We recommend professional service twice a year—once in spring for AC, once in autumn for heating.
